vendor-msa.summary: The agreement contains significant risks for the Client, including unfavorable terms concerning renewal and termination. The indemnification and limitation of liability clauses heavily favor the Provider.

clauses.title: Auto-renewal
clauses.quote: this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twenty-four (24) month periods unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal
clauses.why: The automatic renewal could lead to extended financial commitments without strategic review.
clauses.suggestion: Negotiate for a shorter renewal period or more favorable notice terms.

clauses.title: Fees escalation
clauses.quote: Provider may increase the monthly fee by up to eight percent (8%) upon each renewal term without Client consent
clauses.why: This could lead to unpredictable and increasing costs without the Client's input.
clauses.suggestion: Request a cap on any fee increases or require mutual consent for adjustments.

clauses.title: Indemnification
clauses.quote: Client shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Provider from and against any and all claims
clauses.why: This clause imposes significant liability on the Client for incidents arising from the services provided.
clauses.suggestion: Seek to limit indemnification obligations to cases of Client negligence or misconduct.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.quote: Provider's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid by Client in the three (3) months preceding the claim
clauses.why: The limitation severely caps the Client's recourse for damages caused by Provider's actions.
clauses.suggestion: Propose an increase in liability limits or a waiver of limitations for gross negligence.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.quote: Provider may terminate for convenience at any time upon seven (7) days notice without penalty
clauses.why: This gives the Provider disproportionate power to terminate the agreement without significant lead time.
clauses.suggestion: Request a longer notice period for termination by the Provider to ensure business continuity.

clauses.title: Unilateral amendment
clauses.quote: Provider may modify this Agreement at any time upon thirty (30) days notice
clauses.why: This allows the Provider to unilaterally change terms that may adversely affect the Client’s interests.
clauses.suggestion: Negotiate for mutual agreement required for amendments to any key terms.

saas-subscription.summary: The agreement presents significant risks to the CLIENT, particularly in areas of auto-renewal and liability limitations. Provisions are heavily skewed in favor of the Supplier.

clauses.title: Auto-renewal
clauses.quote: The subscription automatically renews for successive twelve (12) month terms unless Customer gives written notice of non-renewal
clauses.why: This clause can lead to unintended ongoing costs and obligations without client awareness.
clauses.suggestion: Negotiate for a shorter renewal notice period.

clauses.title: Price escalation
clauses.quote: Supplier may adjust subscription fees at each renewal by up to fifteen percent (15%) above the prevailing Consumer Price Index
clauses.why: This exposes the CLIENT to unpredictable cost increases with each renewal.
clauses.suggestion: Request a fixed fee or cap on increases.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.quote: Supplier's total aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the single month preceding the claim.
clauses.why: This severely limits the CLIENT's recourse in case of damages.
clauses.suggestion: Seek to negotiate a higher cap on liability.

clauses.title: Service levels
clauses.quote: Availability below this target does not entitle Customer to any refund, service credit, damages, or termination right
clauses.why: Lack of recourse for service outages impacts CLIENT's operations.
clauses.suggestion: Add provisions for service credits in case of non-compliance.

clauses.title: Suspension
clauses.quote: Supplier may suspend the Service immediately and without notice if Supplier reasonably believes Customer's use violates this Agreement
clauses.why: Immediate suspension can disrupt CLIENT's business without warning.
clauses.suggestion: Introduce a requirement for prior notice and an opportunity to remedy.

clauses.title: Changes to terms
clauses.quote: Supplier may modify this Agreement at any time by posting an updated version on its website.
clauses.why: This allows the Supplier to change terms unilaterally, affecting CLIENT's rights.
clauses.suggestion: Negotiate for mutual agreement on significant changes.

clauses.title: Customer data and exit
clauses.quote: Supplier may delete all Customer Data permanently, and a data retrieval fee of USD 5,000 applies
clauses.why: High costs for data retrieval and potential data loss present major risks to CLIENT.
clauses.suggestion: Remove the data retrieval fee or extend the grace period for data export.

employment-offer.summary: The contract includes several one-sided terms that significantly limit the Employee's rights, posing high risks for the Employee in terms of job security and professional freedom.

clauses.title: Non-compete
clauses.quote: For a period of twenty-four (24) months after termination of employment, for any reason, the Employee shall not directly or indirectly engage in...
clauses.why: This clause severely restricts the Employee's ability to find work in their field after leaving the Company.
clauses.suggestion: Propose to reduce the non-compete duration to six months.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.quote: The Employee shall keep all Company information confidential in perpetuity, including after termination...
clauses.why: The indefinite nature of this confidentiality obligation could hinder future employment opportunities for the Employee.
clauses.suggestion: Negotiate for a more limited duration of confidentiality post-termination.

clauses.title: Training Clawback
clauses.quote: If the Employee resigns within twenty-four (24) months of completing any Company-provided training, the Employee shall repay the full documented cost...
clauses.why: This clause imposes a financial burden on the Employee for leaving the Company unexpectedly, which is disproportionately punitive.
clauses.suggestion: Request to limit the clawback period to twelve months.

clauses.title: Variation of Duties
clauses.quote: The Company may vary the Employee's duties, reporting line, remuneration structure and place of work at any time at its sole discretion.
clauses.why: This clause grants the Company broad discretion, which may lead to instability in the Employee's role and compensation.
clauses.suggestion: Seek clarification on the extent of duties that can be varied and establish mutual consent.

clauses.title: Probation and Notice
clauses.quote: Employment is subject to a six (6) month probationary period, during which either party may terminate with one (1) day notice.
clauses.why: The short notice period during probation may expose the Employee to job insecurity.
clauses.suggestion: Negotiate for a longer notice period during probation.

clauses.title: Governing Law
clauses.quote: This Agreement is governed by the laws of Singapore and the Employee submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Singapore courts.
clauses.why: Choosing a jurisdiction that may be unfavorable to the Employee can limit their legal recourse.
clauses.suggestion: Consider negotiating for a more neutral governing law.
